results.title: Idempotent create via request_id
results.desc: Duplicate CreateSandbox with same request_id must not double-create
results.detail: first grpc=0 ready=ready; retry grpc=0 (); instances-of-name=1
results.prose: CreateSandbox accepts an optional request_id UUID for durable at-most-once admission — the retry-safety story for flaky clients. I created a sandbox with a fresh UUID, then re-issued the exact same create (same name, same request_id) to simulate a client retry. The retry was accepted (grpc=0) and exactly one instance of the sandbox exists — a client that times out and retries gets safe, idempotent behavior.
results.steps: CreateSandbox with request_id=UUID; wait Ready; re-issue identical create; ListSandboxes; count instances of name; cleanup.
